mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 47 degrees with clear skies near Fireman's Park under a third quarter moon.

October is Community Planning Month, honoring the hard work of our planning department, plus the Verona Senior Center is offering free rides on their tri-shaw bikes along the Military Ridge State Trail.
Today you can join a class at Yoga at Insight Wellness, while tomorrow features trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee.
In a notable incident on September 24, an 11-year-old bicyclist was involved in a collision with a vehicle at Westward Drive and Jenna Drive, though thankfully no hospital transport was needed.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
